findings.finding: Invalid canonical UI reference and early execution-authority leakage
findings.resolution: Canonical component-id/UI-path reference is checked against unchanged composition schema; preparation never grants execution; failed apply revokes newly issued approval and preserves prior consent. Independently passed canonical negatives, real compute and grant-cleanup tests.

findings.finding: Kernel/Room provenance and intervening revocation were not fenced
findings.resolution: Session privately constructs and owns Kernel/Room, limits32 rooms/32 instances and exposes no mutable controller. Low-level Proposal/ApplyContext are crate-private. Same-lock policy epoch and room revision checks fence explicit approval; fresh nonce binds every proposal and replacement. Concurrent room/policy/replay tests pass.

findings.finding: Preview cannot be a general side-effect-free staging validator
findings.resolution: Documented advisory validation proves only fixed single-instance, no-edge, no-permission, empty-room construction; own Session capacity and fixed instance identifier constrain resource/identifier risks. Accepted apply_plan remains the atomic commit authority and repeats runtime checks. No general populated-room or graph preview claim is approved.

findings.finding: Initialization and durable checkpoint stages could be conflated
findings.resolution: Actual accepted typed ingress/WASM completion and current valid output projections are checked. Topology, initialization and final durable checkpoint are distinct; actual FileStore write failure after1461.48 computation and genuine guest-trap/direct-form repair are tested. Reacquisition compares storage revision/hash/empty workspace before mutation. Write/rename/fsync acknowledgement ambiguity is explicitly described conservatively.

findings.finding: Qt cancellation could discard an authoritative successful approval
findings.resolution: Cancel is enabled only during prepare. Approval watchdog retains its token/outcome; committed reply triggers accepted Desktop selection. Genuine Qt approve/cancel regression passed; stale preview is invalidated on Desktop drift.

findings.finding: Cancellation queue ownership and oversized replies could lose authority outcomes
findings.resolution: Host-issued Cancellation identity owns prepare lease cleanup; wire cannot supply ticket. Audit tail16 and accepted metadata caps bound replies; oversize fallback preserves authoritative commit and storage flags. Queue ownership and oversize regressions independently passed.

findings.finding: Accepted evidence could be silently weakened or rewritten
findings.resolution: Accepted runtime/room, storage, Desktop and prior collectors remain unchanged;71 accepted review hash entries independently match. New outer wrapper retains full old chain. New collector requires exact named counts and two source-bound reviews, and verifier keeps separate hosted-success/archive checks.
